title: Topic 6
japanese_text: 初心者のうちは<u>絶大な</u>威力の技、<u>ダメージ</u>の<u>数値</u>が大きい技ばかりを使いたがる。しかし、対戦で勝つには、自分の攻撃力をあげたり、相手をやけどさせたりなど、<u>多彩な</u>技を使うことが<u>こつ</u>だ。
english_translation: As a beginner, you tend to want to use only techniques with immense power or a high damage value. However, in order to win matches, the trick is to use diverse techniques, such as increasing your own attack power or burning your opponent.
